description: Pipeworx original random tables: list every built-in table id, title, genre and entry count, optionally filtered to one genre ("fantasy", "scifi" or "modern"). Genre-agnostic tables (loot, weather, npc_*, complication, plot_hook, rumour, settlement_quirk, npc_full) are included under every genre filter, since they apply regardless of setting.

genre.description: Optional genre filter. Omit to list every table.
